premises.text: Small businesses depend on freight brokers whose quotes take days with hidden fees, documents/status updates are slow, margins are fat, and brokers disappear when things go wrong

premises.text: Shipster gives transparent rated access to trucking, warehouse, customs, and ocean providers with unified documents/communication and reliability insights from customs data, completing in minutes what took days and saving 30–60%

premises.text: A sister site lets service providers onboard, update pricing, and manage shipments

value.text: SMEs book international ocean shipping faster, cheaper, and with transparent control over providers
value.evidence_span: Today, what takes days, Shipster does in minutes
